notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
easyPrerequisites: Tandem Lookout paired with Molten Gatekeeper.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Gatekeeper, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Molten Gatekeeper triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
